author: VanZandtVS
body:
That's a great item.   It's basically a band of gods with slightly worse bonuses, but you also get some +luck which the band of gods doesn't offer. 

Keep it.  There's a place for it even once you have a band of gods in case you want an omni farming accessory and you don't mind the nerf to gold, orns, and xp bonuses on the BoG.


For reference, a normal quality BoG boosts gold / orns / xp gain by 50%.

That Ornate quality bag of Treats gives you a 28.75% bonus to orns / xp, 31.25% to gold, and 37.5% bonus to luck.
